source_row.extraction_instructions: The calendar is a JS month grid mixing events with on-demand series and award windows. The three category listings (/meetings/courses, /meetings/joint-section-meetings, /meetings/other-neurosurgical-meetings) render div.list-item cards (title link /meetings-detail/<slug>, EventStartDate_s, EventEndDate_s, Teaser_s) and are loaded with the browser; spans over 14 days and past events are dropped. The Annual Meeting comes from the static /meetings/past-and-future-annual-meetings; its microsite /annualmeeting/overview holds the Member and Non-member fee grids (Early Bird/Advanced/Regular) and is attached only to the edition whose year the headers carry. Detail pages: '<format>/<title>/<venue | city, ST>/<dates>', Pricing table, Hotel, ACCME credit text. Third-party symposia link to the organiser page, read for public fees via fetch_validated. Nothing from this site is sent to llm_call (site forbids AI use); description and specialty are deterministic.

concerns: Registered INACTIVE 2026-10-22: site terms restrict automated access / third-party use — owner decision pending (see PLAN.md).

AI TERMS: cns.org/cns-terms-service forbids integrating CNS content into bots/software using AI technologies. Extractor never calls llm_call (0 calls). The shared merge step / remediator could still send page text to the LLM: owner-level exclusion from LLM steps would be needed (shared files). Automated access itself is not prohibited in the text I read; robots.txt has no AI block.

Browser-first listing (JS): shell counts identical on repeated runs and under --force-fallback (10 / 10 / 10). Each category listing shows a 'N - M of T results' line; the extractor logs a WARNING if T exceeds the cards read (default page size 10; today max 5 per list). Pagination is not followed.

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges verified; fees on the event's own page (same host) or, for the one third-party symposium, on the organiser page via check_url_safe + fetch_validated (second hop, 1 request); no image fee tables seen; Annual Meeting fee grids carry no currency symbol issue ($). Harness --coverage: clean on all sampled rows.

Stale-edition guard: /annualmeeting is always the CURRENT edition. The 2027 Annual Meeting row (Oct 23-27, Phoenix) therefore gets dates and city only, never the 2026 fee grids or description; verified. 2026 early/advanced windows (5/31, 9/30) are already past and are kept with their deadlines because the page still shows them.

Rows without pricing are justified: Written/Oral Board Review (virtual, pricing section absent), Joint Tumor Section Symposium (Oct 2027) and ASSFN Biennial Meeting (Mar 2028) are save-the-dates with an empty page. The Oral Board teaser says March 21-27 while the header says Mar 20-21: site inconsistency, header dates used.

Dropped by rule (INFO logged): on-demand series with spans of years (webinar series, SANS exams, Virtual Visiting Professor) and award/scholarship application windows (Nov 13 - Jan 31). Past events on the Other Neurosurgical Meetings list (Apr-Jul 2026) are dropped by date. The Annual Meeting 2028 (Sept 16-20, Nashville) is beyond the 18-month horizon.
The /meetings/calendar page itself is never used (it is a JS month grid); its internal /api/fusioncontent/* endpoints were looked at during recon but are NOT called by the extractor.
